== Skywalker Ranch (21 October 2026) ==
* Per Bill (personal communication, 21 October 2026), •Skywalker Ranch is not a joke and not a playtest card: it is a special promotional card made to show Lucasfilm. Removed "Joke and unpublished concepts..." line and the inventory row ("Joke two-sided location"); the card now has its own short section with the scan, linked from the lead. [[Skywalker Ranch]] redirects to that section.
* Sources: Bill (personal communication) for what the card is; SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 3 (card image, game text, 2000 copyright line; capture checked by sha256 from the VPS).
=== Marginal cuts ===
* "Joke" framing (unsourced). "Light/Dark site" side label dropped; the section says the same text is on both halves.
=== Missing data ===
* No published source gives when or where Decipher showed the card to Lucasfilm, or how many were made.
